value.rationale: The issue is not merely an isolated zero-over-zero evaluation. The exact singular state is approached through an open punctured neighborhood on which the source defaults produce a nonvanishing fixed-size step and unbounded one-step objective-gap amplification on a smooth strongly convex quadratic. This directly tests the purpose of the adaptive epsilon, which the source motivates as a division-by-zero safeguard, and clarifies why the fixed-positive-epsilon convergence proof it cites does not automatically transfer. A precise positive-floor repair is immediate.
